section.title: Git
section.description: Built-in Gitea service and external Git platform connections. Eidolon only connects to external platforms — it never installs them.

builtin.title: Gitea (Built-in)
builtin.description: Self-hosted Git service for employee accounts and project repositories.
builtin.dockerUnavailable: Docker unavailable — the built-in Gitea container cannot run.
builtin.installing: Installing Gitea… (pulling the image and creating the container, this can take a few minutes)
builtin.installConfirmText: This will pull the gitea/gitea image and create the container eidolon-gitea, listening on 127.0.0.1:26990 (Web) and 127.0.0.1:26922 (SSH).
builtin.errorHint: The built-in Gitea is in an error state — check the Docker daemon and try again.

connections.title: External connections
connections.description: Connect to existing Git platforms (GitLab, Gitea, GitHub Enterprise, or custom). Eidolon only connects to these platforms — it never installs them.
connections.emptyHint: Add an external Git platform connection, or install the built-in Gitea above.
connections.deleteConfirmText: Anything using this connection will lose access to the platform. This cannot be undone.

form.addDescription: Connect to an existing Git platform. The token is write-only; only the masked credential is ever shown.
form.name: Name
form.tokenHint: Write-only — only the masked credential is shown afterwards.
form.required: Name and Base URL are required.
